subject: Agriculture
title: AI-Powered Crop Diagnosis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on AI-Powered Crop Diagnosis.

hook.text: Snap a photo of a sick leaf, and AI identifies the disease in seconds. PlantVillage's app diagnosed 30 million crops.

buildup.text: Smallholder farmers rarely have access to agronomists. Disease identification depends on experience and luck.

discovery.text: Computer vision trained on millions of plant images can identify diseases with over 95% accuracy—better than many experts.

twist.text: The app works offline on basic smartphones—critical for farmers without reliable internet in rural areas.

climax.text: AI diagnosis paired with treatment recommendations can prevent crop losses of 20–40% in developing countries.

punchline.text: A photo and an algorithm replace years of training. AI democratized diagnosis.

quiz.question: How accurate is AI-powered crop disease identification?
